name: Aruba Switch Port Connectivity Failure
checks: Run diagnose_aruba_port against the exact configured Aruba switch and port.
Follow the returned primary_finding and perform only the returned next_check.
If physical/link evidence passes, continue to VLAN/addressing/gateway checks.
stop_condition: Stop immediately when live switch evidence isolates a physical, administrative, interface-error, or MAC-learning fault.
resolution: Apply the smallest correction to the isolated layer. Do not change VLAN/routing configuration when the live evidence indicates a physical-link problem.
validation: Confirm port link state is up where expected.
Confirm the expected MAC/LLDP neighbour appears.
Confirm the endpoint receives expected network connectivity.
